newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: IDT's Singapore placement shares fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: IDT's Singapore placement shares fully subscribed.

text.p: The placement tranche of shares offered by IDT Holdings (Singapore) Ltd, a unit of Hong Kong's IDT International Ltd, has been fully subscribed, manager, underwriter and placement agent Vickers Ballas said on Wednesday.
The 17.664 million placement shares at US$0.73 each are being offered as part of the company's Singapore initial public offer (IPO) of 22.08 million shares.

"There are interests for the entire placement tranche but we haven't allocated the interests yet," Lim Swee Len, Vickers Ballas' director of corporate finance told reporters after an IDT Holdings (Singapore) briefing on its IPO.

Lim said interests for the placement portion were coming from domestic investors and overseas institutions. She said Vickers was still receiving interests and would allocate the placement shares later.
IDT Holdings (Singapore)'s offer closes on January 23 and trading is scheduled to start on January 27.
